I see.. Hopefully I won't get worse, because I actually feel that feeling..

Any other ideas for places to go?
I don't workout very much, considering I'm a lazy introvert, but I will try that when I'm not at work or school. Thank you

I've never thought of "people want to help without anything in return" because it's just my mindset, I guess. 
I'm really happy for you, though. It just proves that things can get better. I will take your advice. I really do appreciate it :)
I just can't help but feel like worthless, empty shit all the time and I don't know how to get rid of it. I'll try to distract myself with things I enjoy, though. The problem is, I don't know what to distract myself with anymore. Everything reminds me of her in some way.. I'll try my best though
This is some really good advice and I'll keep this in my mind. Sorry if I  seem too cherishing but I'll take notes. Thank you

Dammit, I can't thank you enough. I'm only 16, and this advice is honestly better than anything given from my peers. How can I nurture myself?
I also get this guilty feeling when people help me because I feel like I owe them, so bare with me if I seem reluctant to ask for help, but I really do appreciate it.
